title: Reconfiguring Procedural Knowledge for Compositional Robot Skill Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2611.22174v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: General-purpose behavior models increasingly internalize broad procedural knowledge during training, making their adaptation to new goals and skill interfaces less a problem of learning entirely new behaviors than of reconfiguring existing competence. We study this capability as reconfigurability, the ability to realize new behaviors by cost-efficiently restructuring existing components and relations under sparse governing information, where task specifications provide high-level goals and procedure specifications expose a limited set of reusable factors, leaving the concrete bindings and compositions required for execution underdetermined. We propose RecPo, a framework that represents skills task-agnostically through multiple procedure views and materializes executable skill sequences by composing stored transitions to realize task-specific changes. RecPo maintains a procedure knowledge base of skill-induced transitions, with each view

translated_title: 面向组合式机器人技能自适应的程序性知识重构
translated_abstract: 通用行为模型在训练过程中日益内化了广泛的程序性知识，这使得它们对新目标和技能接口的适应，与其说是学习全新的行为，不如说是重构已有的能力。我们将这种能力研究为“可重构性”，即在稀疏的指导信息下，通过低成本地重组现有的组件与关系来实现新行为的能力；其中任务规范提供高层目标，程序规范暴露一组有限的可复用因子，而执行所需的具体绑定与组合则是欠定的（未完全确定的）。我们提出了RecPo，一个通过多个程序视图以任务无关的方式表示技能、并通过组合存储的转移来具体化可执行技能序列从而实现任务特定变化的框架。RecPo维护一个由技能引发的转移所构成的程序性知识库，每个视图……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出RecPo框架，以任务无关的多视图程序性知识库表示技能，并通过组合已存储的转移序列，在稀疏指导信息下低成本地重构机器人已有技能以适应新目标和新技能接口。
en_tdlr: RecPo is a framework that represents procedural skills task-agnostically through multiple procedure views and composes stored transitions, enabling cost-efficient reconfiguration of a robot's existing competence to adapt to new goals and skill interfaces under sparse guidance.
